en.tool.description: Start/stop/monitor the pybitchat BLE Mesh node. Peer discovery events are shown as [INFO] notifications in the terminal.
en.param.action.description: Action: start (begin BLE scan/advertise), stop (shutdown), status (current state).
en.param.nostr.description: Enable Nostr relay transport in addition to BLE.
en.param.nostr_relays.description: Comma-separated Nostr relay URLs (default: x.kojira.io, nos.lol, snort.social).
en.param.nostr_nsec.description: Optional Nostr nsec private key hex (auto-generated if not set).
en.param.mode.description: Chat mode (action=chat_mode): 'on' = mesh forwarding only (LLM injection disabled), 'llm' = mesh forwarding + inject peer msgs to LLM, 'off' = disabled.
en.param.on_message_prompt.description: Optional prompt injected into the LLM when a message arrives.
en.msg.started: pybitchat BLE Mesh node started on %(network)s as %(nickname)s.
en.msg.started_with_error: pybitchat BLE Mesh node started but scanner failed: %(error)s. Check Bluetooth adapter or run pybitchat_subscribe action=status for details.
en.cmd.chat_on: bitchat chat mode: ON (mesh forwarding active)
en.geo.error_nostr_not_running: Error: Nostr transport is not running. Start bitchat with nostr=true first.
en.geo.joined_desc: Receiving messages from users in this area via Nostr.
en.geo.usage_join_auto: No GPS position available. Usage: :bitchat geo join <lat> <lng> [precision=6]
en.cmd.node_started: bitchat BLE Mesh node started on %(network)s as %(nickname)s.
en.cmd.node_already_running: bitchat BLE Mesh node already running as %(nickname)s.

ja.tool.description: pybitchat BLE Mesh ノードの起動・停止・状態監視を行います。ピア発見イベントはターミナルに [INFO] 通知として表示されます。
ja.param.action.description: 操作: start (BLEスキャン/アドバタイズ開始), stop (停止), status (状態確認)。
ja.param.nickname.description: ノードのニックネーム。ピアに表示されます。
ja.param.network.description: ネットワーク: mainnet または testnet。
ja.param.nostr.description: BLE に加えて Nostr リレートランスポートを有効にします。
ja.param.nostr_relays.description: カンマ区切りの Nostr リレーURL（デフォルト: x.kojira.io, nos.lol, snort.social）。
ja.param.nostr_nsec.description: オプションの Nostr nsec 秘密鍵（16進）。未設定の場合は自動生成されます。
ja.param.on.description: bitchat チャットモードの有効/無効を切り替えます（action=chat_mode）。

ja.param.on_message_prompt.description: メッセージ受信時にLLMに注入するオプションのプロンプト。

fil.tool.description: Simulan/ihinto/subaybayan ang pybitchat BLE Mesh node. Ang mga kaganapan sa pagtuklas ng peer ay ipinapakita bilang mga notification ng [INFO] sa terminal.
fil.param.action.description: Pagkilos: simulan (simulan ang BLE scan/advertise), stop (shutdown), status (kasalukuyang estado).
fil.param.nickname.description: Node nickname na ipinapakita sa mga kapantay.
fil.param.nostr.description: Paganahin ang Nostr relay transport bilang karagdagan sa BLE.
fil.param.nostr_relays.description: Mga URL ng Nostr relay na pinaghihiwalay ng kuwit (default: x.kojira.io, nos.lol, snort.social).
fil.param.nostr_nsec.description: Opsyonal na Nostr nsec private key hex (auto-generated kung hindi nakatakda).
fil.param.on.description: Paganahin/huwag paganahin ang bitchat chat mode (action=chat_mode).
fil.param.mode.description: Chat mode (action=chat_mode): 'on' = mesh forwarding lang (LLM injection disabled), 'llm' = mesh forwarding + inject peer msgs to LLM, 'off' = disabled.
fil.param.on_message_prompt.description: Opsyonal na prompt na inilagay sa LLM kapag may dumating na mensahe.
fil.msg.started: Nagsimula ang pybitchat BLE Mesh node noong %(network)s bilang %(nickname)s.
fil.msg.stopped: Tumigil ang pybitchat BLE Mesh node.
fil.msg.started_with_error: Nagsimula ang pybitchat BLE Mesh node ngunit nabigo ang scanner: %(error)s. Suriin ang Bluetooth adapter o patakbuhin ang pybitchat_subscribe action=status para sa mga detalye.
fil.cmd.chat_on: bitchat chat mode: NAKA-ON (aktibo ang mesh forwarding)

fil.geo.error_invalid_coords: Error: dapat na mga numero ang lat/lng

ms.tool.description: Mulakan/hentikan/pantau nod BLE Mesh pybitchat. Peristiwa penemuan rakan sebaya ditunjukkan sebagai pemberitahuan [INFO] dalam terminal.
ms.param.action.description: Tindakan: mula (mulakan imbasan/iklan BLE), berhenti (tutup), status (keadaan semasa).
ms.param.nickname.description: Nama panggilan nod ditunjukkan kepada rakan sebaya.
ms.param.nostr.description: Dayakan pengangkutan geganti Nostr sebagai tambahan kepada BLE.
ms.param.nostr_relays.description: URL geganti Nostr yang dipisahkan koma (lalai: x.kojira.io, nos.lol, snort.social).
ms.param.nostr_nsec.description: Hex kunci peribadi Nostr nsec pilihan (dijana secara automatik jika tidak ditetapkan).
ms.param.mode.description: Mod sembang (action=chat_mode): 'on' = mesh forwarding sahaja (LLM injection disabled), 'llm' = mesh forwarding + inject peer msgs to LLM, 'off' = disabled.
ms.param.on_message_prompt.description: Gesaan pilihan disuntik ke dalam LLM apabila mesej tiba.
ms.msg.started: pybitchat BLE Mesh nod bermula pada %(network)s sebagai %(nickname)s.
ms.msg.started_with_error: pybitchat BLE Mesh nod bermula tetapi pengimbas gagal: %(error)s. Semak penyesuai Bluetooth atau jalankan pybitchat_subscribe action=status untuk mendapatkan butiran.
ms.cmd.chat_on: mod sembang bitchat: HIDUP (pemajuan jaringan aktif)
ms.geo.error_nostr_not_running: Ralat: Nostr transport tidak berjalan. Mulakan bitchat dengan nostr=true dahulu.
ms.geo.joined_desc: Menerima mesej daripada pengguna di kawasan ini melalui Nostr.
ms.geo.usage_join_auto: Tiada kedudukan GPS tersedia. Penggunaan: :bitchat geo join <lat> <lng> [precision=6]
ms.geo.auto_detected: Kedudukan yang dikesan secara automatik: lat=%(lat)s, lng=%(lng)s (ketepatan=%(precision)d)
ms.cmd.node_started: bitchat BLE Mesh nod bermula pada %(network)s sebagai %(nickname)s.
ms.cmd.node_already_running: bitchat BLE Mesh nod sudah berjalan sebagai %(nickname)s.

da.tool.description: Start/stop/overvåg pybitchat BLE Mesh-noden. Peer-opdagelseshændelser vises som [INFO]-meddelelser i terminalen.
da.param.action.description: Handling: start (begynd BLE-scanning/annoncering), stop (lukning), status (aktuel tilstand).
da.param.nostr_nsec.description: Valgfri Nostr nsec privat nøgle hex (automatisk genereret, hvis ikke indstillet).
da.param.mode.description: Chattilstand (action=chat_mode): 'on' = kun mesh-videresendelse (LLM-injektion deaktiveret), 'llm' = mesh-videresendelse + injicer peer-beskeder til LLM, 'off' = deaktiveret.
da.param.on_message_prompt.description: Valgfri prompt injiceret i LLM, når der ankommer en besked.
da.msg.started: pybitchat BLE Mesh node startede på %(network)s som %(nickname)s.
da.msg.started_with_error: pybitchat BLE Mesh node startede, men scanneren mislykkedes: %(error)s. Tjek Bluetooth-adapter eller kør pybitchat_subscribe action=status for detaljer.
da.geo.error_nostr_not_running: Fejl: Nostr-transport kører ikke. Start bitchat med nostr=true først.
da.geo.joined_desc: Modtagelse af beskeder fra brugere i dette område via Nostr.
da.geo.usage_join_auto: Ingen GPS-position tilgængelig. Brug: :bitchat geo join <lat> <lng> [præcision=6]
da.cmd.node_started: bitchat BLE Mesh node startede på %(network)s som %(nickname)s.
da.cmd.node_already_running: bitchat BLE Mesh node kører allerede som %(nickname)s.

nn.param.action.description: Handling: start (begynn BLE-skanning/annonsering), stopp (avslutting), status (nåværende tilstand).
nn.param.nostr.description: Aktiver Nostr relétransport i tillegg til BLE.
nn.param.nostr_nsec.description: Valgfri Nostr nsec privat nøkkel hex (automatisk generert hvis ikke angitt).
nn.param.mode.description: Chat-modus (action=chat_mode): 'on' = berre mesh-videresending (LLM-injeksjon deaktivert), 'llm' = mesh-videresending + injiser peer-meldinger til LLM, 'off' = deaktivert.
nn.param.on_message_prompt.description: Valgfri melding injisert i LLM når en melding kommer.
nn.msg.started: pybitchat BLE Mesh-noden startet på %(network)s som %(nickname)s.
nn.msg.started_with_error: pybitchat BLE Mesh-noden startet, men skanneren mislukkast: %(error)s. Sjekk Bluetooth-adapteren eller kjør pybitchat_subscribe action=status for detaljer.
nn.geo.error_nostr_not_running: Feil: Nostr-transport kjører ikke. Start bitchat med nostr=true først.
nn.geo.joined_desc: Motta meldingar frå brukarar i dette området via Nostr.
nn.geo.usage_join_auto: Ingen GPS-posisjon tilgjengeleg. Bruk: :bitchat geo join <lat> <lng> [precision=6]
nn.cmd.node_started: bitchat BLE Mesh-noden startet på %(network)s som %(nickname)s.
nn.cmd.node_already_running: bitchat BLE Mesh-noden kjører allerede som %(nickname)s.
